title.en: An Act Naming a National Highway From the Municipality of Pavia Up to the Municipality of Janiuay, Province of Iloilo, as the Tomas Confesor Highway
title.orig: An Act Naming a National Highway From the Municipality of Pavia Up to the Municipality of Janiuay, Province of Iloilo, as the Tomas Confesor Highway

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1989/ra_6696_1989.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The national highway starting from Km. 10 + 000 in the Municipality of Pavia to Km. 33 + 000 in the Municipality of Janiuay shall be known as the Tomas Confesor Highway.
Any law, ordinance, administrative order, designation or identification shall be considered repealed or modified accordingly.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
